fields.quoted_span:
“Residential dwelling unit” means any house, apartment,
accessory unit, or other unit intended to be used as a primary residence in the
State. “Residential dwelling unit” shall not include inpatient medical care,
licensed long-term care, or detention or correctional facilities.
fields.note: The one-or-more-units owner definition, the controlling-interest single-owner rule and the municipal conflict bar (preemption) are all in the text.
The document gives the citation as P.L. 2026, c.043, which is equivalent to P.L.2026, c.43. The chapter and section ranges C.56:9-20 to 56:9-26 also appear.
